title: Suspicious PowerShell Execution from Office Application
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
  process: powershell.exe
condition:
  - process.parent.name in ['winword.exe', 'excel.exe', 'outlook.exe', 'powerpnt.exe']
  - 'hidden' in process.command_line
  - 'encodedcommand' in process.command_line
level: high
detection:
  selection:
    ParentProcessName:
      - '*\\winword.exe'
      - '*\\excel.exe'
      - '*\\outlook.exe'
      - '*\\powerpnt.exe'
    CommandLine:
      - '*-w hidden*'
      - '*-nop*'
      - '*-encodedcommand*'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate administrative scripts launched from Office (rare)
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1566/001/
date: 2026-04-11
author: SOC Team
